integrity_note: The proof rests on an exhaustively verified finite signed integral discrete-Morse calculation and two independent finite Lefschetz-trace methods. Neither bibliographic novelty nor independent scientific validation is certified by these computations.
scientific_limitations: Only the Desargues graph and its ordinary independence complex; no general graph family. The fifth rational symmetry representation is determined, but its integral representation lattice is not classified. An inaccessible general incidence-graph paper and unindexed literature remain bibliographic risks.
title: The \(S_5\times C_2\) homology character of the Desargues independence complex
